mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_transfer WHERE transfer_no = #{transferNo} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT * FROM inventory_transfer WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT * FROM inventory_transfer WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_transfer SET status = 'SHIPPED', shipped_at = #{shippedAt}, shipped_by = #{shippedBy}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{shippedBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND status = 'DRAFT'

UPDATE inventory_transfer SET status = 'RECEIVED', received_at = #{receivedAt}, received_by = #{receivedBy}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{receivedBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND status = 'SHIPPED'
UPDATE inventory_transfer SET status = 'CANCELLED', version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND status = 'DRAFT'

UPDATE inventory_transfer SET from_warehouse_id = #{fromWarehouseId}, to_warehouse_id = #{toWarehouseId}, remark = #{remark}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{operator} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.transfer_no, t.from_warehouse_id, t.to_warehouse_id, t.status, t.remark, t.shipped_at, t.shipped_by, t.received_at, t.received_by, t.version, t.created_at, t.updated_at, fw.warehouse_code AS from_warehouse_code, fw.name AS from_warehouse_name, tw.warehouse_code AS to_warehouse_code, tw.name AS to_warehouse_name FROM inventory_transfer t LEFT JOIN warehouse fw ON fw.id = t.from_warehouse_id LEFT JOIN warehouse tw ON tw.id = t.to_warehouse_id WHERE t.deleted = FALSE AND t.id = #{id}
